text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, some clothes arrived from home...
and there's an outfit that would look so perfect on you, Groove-san♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I really don't think
that would suit me, though...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Just once is fine, as a test!
Please, try it on and show me♪
Come on, arms up!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! What do you mean 'Hooray'!
Alright, alright, just trying it on, okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Kh...!?
Wh-What is the meaning of this...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It didn't fit...? That's impossible.
Could I have... gained weight...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
True, I might have let my guard down
a bit lately, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should add a workout to lean out.
I'll have to consult him first, though.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, wait!
Looking closely, these clothes are for kids—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, he's gone.
I'll have to tell him once we get back♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although it all started with a misunderstanding,
Air Groove later successfully
managed to complete her diet.
